def find_proper_divisors(n: int) -> Set[int]:
    """
    Find all proper divisors of a number.
    - O(sqrt(n)) time-complexity
    - O(n) space-complexity
    """

    divisors = find_divisors(n)
    return divisors - {n}  # without n
